dialogues.speaker: Little Kuang
dialogues.text: For example, there are absolutely huge goats in the village to the south, ten times larger than the goats in any book!

dialogues.speaker: Little Kuang
dialogues.text: While floating over on a bamboo raft, I saw a jade ornament the size of a mountain... A jade ring? A jade pendant? What was it again...

dialogues.speaker: Little Kuang
dialogues.text: Whatever! Forget it! I'll figure it out one day.

dialogues.speaker: Little Kuang
dialogues.text: A girl fishing by the waterfall said there's a type of Carp in Chenyu Vale that bestows good luck upon those who see it! I wanna find one!

dialogues.speaker: Little Kuang
dialogues.text: The most interesting is the Wushou Dance that Dip Yeuk and his friends are doing! They're like big cats with painted faces nimbly jumping up and down!

dialogues.speaker: Little Kuang
dialogues.text: Anyway... Everything here is so novel! So many things here I've never seen or heard of before!
